leaseContract.authority: Only a trusted OBS-BGSTAB-005 evidence digest, stable reviewed profile, matching compiler schema and exact consumer capability N can issue an opaque PolicyLease.
leaseContract.accepted: exact capability N with selected connectionId/reconnectGeneration and exact resource-consumer pair
leaseContract.consumerApis: RuntimeConfigStore, WsRouter and frontend canary transition APIs accept a validated opaque lease, never raw candidate cap or generation.
leaseContract.staleLease: After issuance, replacing either actual router client connectionId or reconnectGeneration denies queue preview and ledger read, returns no entries, and leaves the actual queue hash unchanged.

resourceTruth.accounting: aggregate all subscribed sessions from the router-owned client queue using actual JSON UTF-8 transport byteLength

behavioralCoverage.queueOwnership: caller supplies no queue scalar or snapshot; RuntimeConfigStore must read WsRouter-owned queues and recompute payload byteLength
behavioralCoverage.atomicity: queued and incoming byteLength tampering reject without mutation; accepted and legacy fallback admission append exactly once
behavioralCoverage.targetIsolation: actual client metadata carries connectionId/reconnectGeneration/outputChannel; same client aggregates two sessions; client B remains independent
behavioralCoverage.ledger: capacity+3 accepted plus rejected plus closed rollback; exact latest N contiguous entries, dropped total, complete metadata, payload-free, deeply read-only, A/B isolated
behavioralCoverage.headlessIsolation: actual test queue uses raw PTY UTF-8, headless session A is isolated from another session, WS-only activation leaves headless ledger unchanged, adapter throw rolls back earlier WS activation
behavioralCoverage.rollback: global regression and per-target A/B tests assert each callback stage, duplicate callback safety, immediate legacy admission, final closed ledger and cleanup
behavioralCoverage.frontend: explicit validated-lease API; selected view/connection/reconnect freshness; legacy configure test unchanged; 7/8/9 byte retained FIFO
behavioralCoverage.generation: internal factory option only; body field absent from serialized/coalesced wire; different or defined/undefined generations do not merge
behavioralCoverage.lifecycle: forbidden counters cover activate/stop/drain/disconnect and cleanup reaches zero
